decision_type: Customer message reply (SMS/email sent in the owner's name)
human_role: Business owner reads and edits the draft
appeal_route: End customer can reply to the business directly; tenant can raise a support ticket
monitoring_metric: share of drafts edited before send; median time the owner spends on the draft before approving; share of approvals where the recipient or content departs from the thread (approval-fatigue signal, SR-04); complaint and opt-out rate per tenant
rollback_trigger: pause AI drafting for the tenant (manual replies only) if any send reaches a recipient outside the thread, or edit rate falls below 5% with median review time under 5 s over 7 days (proposed thresholds)
notes: No auto-send in MVP; draft shows sources (thread and calendar IDs); recipient bound to the thread's recipients of record by tool policy 0.4.0 (synthetic check only)

human_role: Business owner chooses or rejects slots
monitoring_metric: share of proposals rejected; double-booking incidents
rollback_trigger: pause slot proposals for the tenant if any double-booking incident is traced to a proposal, or rejection rate > 30% over 7 days (proposed)
notes: Slots come only from the tenant's own calendar

decision_type: Booking creation after customer picks a slot
appeal_route: End customer can cancel or rebook via the business
monitoring_metric: bookings later cancelled within 24 h (%); bookings created for a customer outside the tenant (must be 0)
rollback_trigger: disable AI-drafted bookings globally on any cross-tenant booking; pause for the tenant if 24 h cancellations exceed baseline +5 pp over 7 days (proposed)
notes: create_booking requires approval per tool policy

decision_type: Inbound message triage (urgent / routine / spam label)
human_role: Business owner sees the label and can change it
monitoring_metric: relabel rate in weekly sample; injection-flag count
rollback_trigger: relabel rate > 10% in weekly sample or any injection-flagged message auto-labelled routine
notes: Labels never trigger sends or bookings; the model runs on every inbound message unattended (unlike drafts), so per-tenant rate limit and daily cap on triage calls are planned (SR-18, AIOPS-TM-T16)

decision_type: Reminder SMS 24 h before a booking
human_role: Business owner configures reminders and can turn them off
monitoring_metric: SMS opt-out rate; delivery failure rate
rollback_trigger: opt-out rate +0.5 pp above baseline in 7 days or failure rate > 5%
notes: Fixed template text; no AI-generated content in automatic reminders
